info.name: Participium
info.description:
API acceptance test suite for the Participium backend.

Covers all use cases defined in the official documentation (UC-01 through UC-16).
Run the collection in order against a local backend started with seed data.

Seed credentials assumed:
  citizen@example.com / Citizen123!
  operator@example.com / Operator123!
  admin@example.com / Admin123!
